# MCTL — AI-Native Infrastructure Management Platform

> MCTL is a multi-tenant Kubernetes platform for managing GitOps deployments, microservices, databases, and automated workflows via Model Context Protocol (MCP) and REST APIs.

## Key Documentation Links

- [Getting Started](https://docs.mctl.ai/getting-started/): Installation and setup guide for developers and SREs.
- [MCP Connecting Guide](https://docs.mctl.ai/mcp/connecting): How to connect Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, or Antigravity to mctl.
- [MCP Tools Reference](https://docs.mctl.ai/mcp/tools-reference): Catalog of 54 platform tools for environment operations.
- [Troubleshooting & FAQs](https://docs.mctl.ai/reference/troubleshooting): Resolving common deployment and RBAC issues.

## Primary Core Tools

- **Tenant Management**: `mctl_create_tenant`, `mctl_get_tenant`, `mctl_delete_tenant`
- **Service Operations**: `mctl_deploy_service`, `mctl_scale_service`, `mctl_rollback_service`, `mctl_retire_service`
- **Workflows & Observability**: `mctl_get_workflow_logs`, `mctl_get_workflow_status`, `mctl_list_incidents`, `mctl_resolve_incident`
- **OpenClaw Operator**: `mctl_deploy_openclaw`, `mctl_save_openclaw_skill`, `mctl_save_openclaw_identity`
- **Platform Skills**: `mctl_list_platform_skills`, `mctl_read_platform_skill`, `mctl_publish_platform_skill`

## Optional / Full Specs

- [Full Consolidated Context (llms-full.txt)](https://docs.mctl.ai/llms-full.txt): Single-file compilation of all 28+ documentation files (~30k tokens).
- [Full Tools Reference](https://docs.mctl.ai/mcp/tools-reference): Complete parameter specs for all 54 MCP tools.
- [Architecture & GitOps](https://docs.mctl.ai/guides/deploy-first-app): Detailed guide on ArgoCD and mctl-api synchronization.
